Criteria for Visa Extension

Travelers must meet specific criteria. It is the eligibility criteria for a visit visa extension. One should generally have:

  • A valid visit visa that is not expired.
  • A passport with at least six months of validity remaining.
  • When you haven’t overstayed your current visa. You are allowed to extend your visa. This is for an additional 30 days or more under the new rules. However, it depends on your circumstances.

Processing Times for Visa Extensions

The processing time for a visa extension ranges from 2 to 5 working days. Apply for the extension at least a week before your current visa expires. The practice is advisable. As it helps to avoid any complications. Receive confirmation of your extension via email. This allows you to plan your activities without interruption.

Documents for Dubai Visit Visa Extension

Gather the following documents when applying for a visit visa extension:

  • A copy of your passport and the current visit visa.
  • A recent passport-sized photograph.
  • Proof of accommodation in Dubai. This includes hotel booking or tenancy contracts.
  • A completed application form. It can be found online or obtained from the relevant authorities.
  • Visa extension fee payment. It varies based on the duration of the extension requested.

Tips for a Smooth Application Process Under the New Rules

Comparing Old and New Rules for Dubai Visit Visa Extensions

It is essential to understand the changes in the rules for Dubai visit visa extensions. Especially for travelers looking to extend their stay. Below is a comparison of the old and new rules to help you navigate the process effectively.

Extension Duration:

Old Rules: Visit visas could be extended for a maximum of 30 days without much flexibility.

New Rules: Under the new regulations, travelers may now apply for extensions of up to 60 days, allowing for a longer stay and more time to explore.

Eligibility Criteria:

Old Rules: Extensions were often limited to visitors. The ones who had a valid visa and could demonstrate a genuine reason for the extension.

New Rules: Eligibility criteria have been relaxed. Now, as long as you haven’t overstayed and your visit visa is valid. In this condition, you can get an extension due to lesser stringent requirements.

Application Process

Old Rules: The application process was often cumbersome. It requires multiple visits to government offices and a considerable amount of paperwork.

New Rules: The entire application process has been eased by making many steps available online and allowing travelers to file applications and track the status of their applications through official portals.

Processing Time:

Old Rules: Visa extensions could take up to a week or more to process. It causes potential disruption to travel plans.

New Rules: Processing times have improved. The applications are processed within 2 to 5 working days. It allows for quicker resolutions.

Fees:

Old Rules: The fees for visa extensions were often higher. It could vary significantly depending on the authority.

New Rules: The fees still apply. However, the new regulations aim to provide clearer guidelines on costs. This makes it easier for travelers to budget for their extensions.
